ideas.title: Following the Money in the 2020 Georgia Election Investigation
ideas.description: An in-depth examination of the financial transactions and funding sources involved in the 2020 Georgia election investigation.
questions: What were the sources of funding for the 2020 Georgia election?
Were there any irregularities in the financial transactions?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential financial irregularities or corruption in the 2020 Georgia election, and provide a deeper understanding of the investigation.

ideas.title: Uncovering Non-profit Fraud and Corruption
ideas.description: An investigation into the non-profit sector to identify patterns of fraud and corruption, and examine the effectiveness of current oversight and regulation.
questions: What are the most common types of non-profit fraud?
How effective are current regulations in preventing non-profit corruption?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the scope and nature of non-profit fraud and corruption, and provide recommendations for improved oversight and regulation.
